_schema.purpose: The canonical, append-only per-position evidence record for v1.34's dual-arm bench sweep (Phases 160-166). One row per evidence position (<cell_slug>__<arm>__<chip>, bench/IMAGE-PLAN.json's primary key). Phase 160 pins the schema; Phases 161-163 append the 20 sweep-position rows plus Phase 160's own plans 08-12 bring-up rows; Phase 165 classifies failures; Phase 166 closes out by reconciling row count against position_count_expected. bench/EVIDENCE.md is generated from this file by tools/render_evidence.py and is never hand-edited.
_schema.locked_columns_note: locked_columns is the nine-column core pinned verbatim from .planning/v1.15/bench/EVIDENCE.json and .planning/v1.18/bench/EVIDENCE.json, where it is byte-identical -- the stable core every milestone's evidence record has carried. evid_extension_columns is the v1.34-specific set this milestone's dual-arm write/read/judge sweep actually needs (position/arm/provenance/judge fields) that the two prior milestones' single-arm read/write sweeps had no reason to carry. The two-tier shape exists so the close-out phase (166) can assert on the locked core across every milestone's evidence file uniformly, while each sweep phase adds only the columns its own oracle produces -- observed extension keys in this file's rows are exactly the evid_extension_columns list, never the locked_columns list, and never a key outside either list.
_schema.jsonl_convention: One JSON object per line, LF line terminators, UTF-8 without ASCII escaping (ensure_ascii=False). Rows are emitted with keys in exactly record_keys order and are never sorted. This header object (keyed '_schema') is line 1 and is the ONLY line carrying the '_schema' key. No timestamp is recorded anywhere in this file -- not in this header, not in any row -- so a regeneration of bench/EVIDENCE.md over an unchanged row set is byte-identical (see tools/render_evidence.py --check). A row is never rewritten once appended: tools/render_evidence.py's --append path asserts the existing prefix is byte-unchanged immediately before an atomic replace.
_schema.outcome_values_note: outcome_values is the identical two-value list under the field name tools/gate_record.py's check_outcome() already reads from an EVIDENCE.jsonl header (that tool is reused unmodified, not re-implemented here); outcome_domain is the same list under the name this plan pins for D-15/D-18. Both names carry the same value so gate_record.py's per-row domain check and this plan's own pinned field name are simultaneously satisfied from one source of truth.
_schema.bringup_row_exclusion: A row whose cell_id begins with the bring-up prefix 'BRINGUP-' is rig evidence produced by Phase 160's own bring-up plans (08-12), not sweep evidence produced by Phases 161-163 -- it is excluded from the 20-position close-out reconciliation. Exactly one cell (A3/B2) is shared between the two sweeps this milestone runs and is executed exactly once, so exactly one row exists per arm-and-chip position bearing that cell id across the whole milestone -- it is never double-counted and never re-run to produce a second row for the same position_id.
_schema.close01_counting_rule: Computed over the non-bring-up rows only: (number of rows with outcome=='validated') + (number of rows with outcome=='skipped-with-reason') == position_count_expected (20). The first term is 'positions holding a result'; the second is 'positions holding a named reason for absence' (a recorded skip, never a blank). Phase 166's CLOSE-01 close-out arithmetic is this equation evaluated as a script over rows, not a human count -- a silent gap between the row count and 20 is structurally visible as a nonzero remainder rather than something a reader has to notice.
_schema.not_measured_convention: A reading that tooling blocks -- because a bootloader interrogation has not yet been recorded (judged_span_policy: PENDING-xshowvector on uno328pb), because a CLI path does not exist for a value, or for any other named reason -- is recorded as the string 'not measured — <reason>' (em dash or double-hyphen separator) with its blocking reason on the SAME line, never as a blank, null, or omitted field. tools/gate_record.py's field-presence check treats this exact shape as a valid, non-null value and rejects a bare 'not measured' with no reason.
_schema.negative_control_convention: A negative control (the W27C512 VPP-high init guard firing; the deliberate wrong-arm cross-flash producing a MISMATCH) is recorded as having FIRED -- the record states the guard/mismatch actually occurred and what happened next -- never merely as having been configured or made available. A mechanism that was present but never observed to fire is not evidence that it works.
_schema.artifact_volume_policy_ref: bench/IMAGE-PLAN.json's top-level 'artifact_volume_policy' object -- the single home for what is committed vs. kept local vs. committed-on-failure across this milestone's bench artifacts (written images, read-back run_*.bin files, provenance JSON).
